summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) transparent/outlined stroke font removal, (2) Netflix-style course cards, (3) giant 01/02 solid coral low-opacity, plus regressions (preloader, CTAs, pricing toggle, horizontal world) on desktop 1920 and mobile 390. All checks pass.

V2_netflix_cards.note: Video autoplay blocked in headless without user gesture (acceptable per review note). Play() is invoked on hover, DOM assertions confirm hover state.
V2_netflix_cards.hover_scale_extraction: None (transform format may be matrix3d); panel expansion is definitive proof hover applied

critical_code_review_comments: CreatorShowcase.tsx: video preload='none' + autoplay on hover works on real browsers but silently fails in headless — consider a poster image or CSS-based motion fallback for accessibility/reduced-motion users (nice-to-have, not blocking).
globals.css: cursor:none is applied globally on hover-capable devices — acceptable given CustomCursor component, but ensure focus-visible outlines remain intact for keyboard users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 verified stroke-font removal + Netflix card hover behavior + full regression. All 5 verification blocks pass. No blocking issues. Prior iterations 3-5 covered broader landing coverage.
